title: Backend-agnostic web console for any S3-compatible object store
user: Self-hoster or small-ops engineer running an S3-compatible object store who needs a portable browser UI.
smallest_useful_product: A static browser-only S3 console for buckets, objects, metadata, tags, policy, CORS, lifecycle, versioning, multipart transfer and presigned URLs.
constraints: Credentials stay in browser storage and requests go directly to the configured S3 endpoint. The target must allow browser CORS.
